notes: Bans the upstream Click PyPI package and import root (click), the GitHub slug pallets/click, and Typer (typer) which wraps Click; allows runner-provided infra (pytest, apt less, Python/pip/flit_core) and does not ban org-wide or docs-only names (pallets, pallets-sphinx-themes, click-contrib). typer-slim is banned with it: it installs the same typer import package, so leaving it would keep the banned module importable.
